events.subtitle: COTTON CLUB debut — quintet
events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB presents Camille Bertault on Monday, October 12, 2026, for two sets at 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM. The venue identifies this as Bertault's first appearance at COTTON CLUB and emphasizes the scat and improvisational vocal language that brought her international attention. The announced quintet is Bertault with Julien Alour on trumpet, Minino Garay on drums/percussion, Fady Farah on piano, and Sylvain Romano on bass. The exact authorized eplus listing independently confirms both set times, the same five-person lineup, and active general sale through October 8.

en.why_it_matters: Bertault belongs here because the voice is functioning as an improvising instrument, not simply as the melody on top of a jazz rhythm section. The COTTON CLUB debut puts her scat language in a compact quintet with trumpet, piano, bass, and drums/percussion, which should leave plenty of room for phrasing, rhythmic displacement, and actual ensemble reaction rather than a singer-with-band format.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the two sets if October 12 is open in Tokyo, especially if vocal improvisation and unusual instrumental identities are part of the Japan thread. It is a strong city-night anchor, but a first club appearance by an active touring artist does not require rebuilding a larger Japan itinerary around it.

es.why_it_matters: Bertault entra porque aquí la voz funciona como instrumento improvisador, no simplemente como melodía encima de una sección rítmica de jazz. Su debut en COTTON CLUB la pone en un quinteto compacto con trompeta, piano, bajo y batería/percusión, un formato que debería dejar mucho espacio para fraseo, desplazamiento rítmico y reacción real de ensamble en vez de la fórmula cantante-con-banda.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los dos sets si el 12 de octubre está libre en Tokio, sobre todo si la improvisación vocal y las identidades instrumentales raras forman parte del hilo japonés. Es una noche fuerte dentro de la ciudad, pero el debut de club de una artista que sigue girando no obliga a reconstruir un itinerario mayor de Japón alrededor de esta sola fecha.

events.subtitle: RIDE LONESOME TOUR — with Ioanna Gika
events.category: Alternative rock / Current album tour / Songcraft
events.factual_description: The Anthem presents Beck's RIDE LONESOME TOUR on Sunday, October 25, 2026, with doors at 6:00 PM and show at 7:30 PM; the current live venue page lists Ioanna Gika as special guest. Ticketmaster independently confirms the October 25 7:30 PM event at The Anthem. Live Nation's April 21 tour announcement identifies Washington as one stop on a 25-date North American run and frames the tour around the then-new Ride Lonesome material, produced by Beck with the title track mixed by Nigel Godrich and drawing on the spacious sonic territory associated with Morning Phase and Sea Change. Apple Music lists the full Ride Lonesome album for September 18, 2026.

en.why_it_matters: The concrete reason is not simply that Beck has a deep catalog. This tour is tied to a current record that deliberately returns to the spacious, melancholy side of his language while still leaving room for the stylistic pivots that make his live sets unpredictable. At The Anthem, that gives the night more shape than a greatest-hits stop: older acoustic and art-rock material can sit beside a new album built from the same sonic family.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for the Washington date if Beck's shape-shifting songcraft is part of the local listening thread. The 25-date North American itinerary provides plenty of other chances nationally, so this is a strong DMV night rather than a performance that should displace a rarer premiere, farewell, or one-off.

es.why_it_matters: La razón concreta no es simplemente que Beck tenga un catálogo enorme. Esta gira está amarrada a un disco actual que vuelve deliberadamente al costado espacioso y melancólico de su lenguaje, sin perder los cambios de registro que hacen impredecibles sus conciertos. En The Anthem eso le da más forma a la noche que una parada de greatest hits: material acústico y art-rock de otras etapas puede convivir con un disco nuevo que vuelve a esa misma familia sonora.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a la fecha de Washington si el songwriting cambiante de Beck forma parte del hilo local. La gira norteamericana de 25 fechas ofrece muchas otras oportunidades a escala nacional, así que ésta es una noche fuerte del DMV, no una función que deba desplazar un estreno, despedida o one-off mucho más raro.
